author: MuzzBuzz
body:
Hi there,
I would just like to make a complaint about gibbodaman. He has been constantly flaming threads for the last week or 2 and it is really annoying and makes reading the forums and giving your input less fun because you just expect gibbo to come along and flame the thread and argue against you. I find it particularly annoying, upsetting and disappointing. A prime example of this is when Jozz had to lock the Mario Kart thread due to gibbo flaming it. mk7master then proceeded to make a new thread with the same topic as it wasn't his fault which is completely fair. Then gibbo of course has to come along and flame that thread too. This may sound drastic but I am suggesting and rallying along with Zedther, brian45er, Da_Baus and pricey108, to have gibbodaman permanently web banned. This happening would improve the friendly atmosphere of the forums. Any help or action taken is very greatly appreciated.

Anyway, thanks for taking the time to read my report.

Cheers and Kind Regards,
Keaton
